app/api/user/addresses/[id]/route.ts.name: Single address management
app/api/user/addresses/[id]/route.ts.description: Updates or deletes a specific saved address for the signed-in customer.

app/api/user/addresses/route.ts.name: Address book
app/api/user/addresses/route.ts.description: Lists all saved addresses for the signed-in customer and adds new ones.

app/api/user/profile/route.ts.name: Customer profile
app/api/user/profile/route.ts.description: Returns or updates the signed-in customer's name, phone, date of birth and preferences.

PUT /api/user/addresses/[id].name: Update saved address
PUT /api/user/addresses/[id].description: Saves changes to one of the customer's addresses and can set it as the default.

DELETE /api/user/addresses/[id].name: Remove saved address
DELETE /api/user/addresses/[id].description: Deletes a saved address from the customer's address book.

GET /api/user/addresses.name: List saved addresses
GET /api/user/addresses.description: Returns every billing and shipping address the customer has on file.

POST /api/user/addresses.name: Add new address
POST /api/user/addresses.description: Saves a new billing or shipping address to the customer's account.

GET /api/user/profile.name: View customer profile
GET /api/user/profile.description: Returns the signed-in customer's profile details and saved addresses.

PUT /api/user/profile.name: Update customer profile
PUT /api/user/profile.description: Saves changes to the customer's name, phone number, date of birth or preferences.
